cohort: 87 pregnant women (45 with preeclampsia and 42 without)
finding: While mAMH levels were lower in preeclamptic patients, there was no significant association between mAMH levels and adverse maternal or perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery rates were statistically significantly lower in preeclamptic patients compared with non-preeclamptic patients.
birth_weight: Recorded, significantly lower in preeclamptic patients
